name: Command Palette
description: Ctrl+P fuzzy file finder overlay. Recursive directory walk (skips .git, node_modules, .cockpit) to build file index on first search. Throttled 150ms search with substring matching on file name and path, limited to 50 results. Shows recent files (from localStorage) when input is empty. Arrow key navigation, Enter to open, Escape to close. Mouse hover updates selection. Opens file in editor via onSelectFile callback. Recent files persist to localStorage (max 10). Loading state shows progress indicator during initial file walk.

interface.constructor: new CommandPalette(wsPath: string, onSelect: (filePath: string) => void)

methods.name: open
methods.description: Show palette overlay, clear input, focus input

lifecycle.destroyed_by: ExplorerPlugin card close or window close
